question.text: For a 52-year-old business owner with pending children's education in 3 years and retirement in 13 years, a PM should use:

answer.text: One single SAA for all goals
Goals-based buckets with different asset allocations per goal

explanation.text: The Logic: Different goal horizons demand different SAAs — buckets approach. The Trap: One-size-fits-all fails near-term priority goals. Cross-Exam Context: Goals-based framework in X-A, XVII. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Name each bucket explicitly in the IPS (Education-2029, Retirement-2039) with dedicated benchmarks.
